props.name: aria-label
props.description: The input's name when no visible label names it. For a visible label, put the input in a `Field.Root` with a `Field.Label` instead.

props.name: filter
props.description: Keeps digits only. The input strips every other character, typed, pasted or autofilled, before `onChange` and Field validation read the value. It sets `inputMode="numeric"` unless you pass `inputMode`. Use it with a text-like type, since under `type="number"` it also strips the sign and the decimal separator. `maxLength` counts digits when the browser sends a cancelable `beforeinput` on a type with a selection API (`text`, `tel`, `search`, `url`, `password`), so a pasted `912 34 567` fits `maxLength={8}` whole. Elsewhere the browser cuts the text to `maxLength` before the input strips it: under a type without a selection API, such as `email`, and for autofill that sends no cancelable `beforeinput`. There a pasted `912 34 567` becomes `912345`. An uncontrolled numeric input restores its `defaultValue` on a native form reset without calling `onChange`.

props.name: size
props.description: The control size, also written as `data-size`. `default` is the md control size, and `sm` the sm one. It replaces the native numeric `size` attribute, so set the width with a class.
